galatea_get_capabilities.description: Read the supported Galatea protocol, actions and governance capabilities for the configured principal.

galatea_list_projects.description: List projects visible to the configured principal using bounded pagination.

galatea_inspect_project.description: Inspect the approved project contract, immutable input identities and execution backend.

galatea_get_campaign.description: Read a scoped campaign's current revision, authorization and resource budget.

galatea_list_operations.description: List existing operations within the principal's campaign scope; this does not submit jobs.

galatea_get_operation.description: Read an existing operation and its authoritative receipt for reconciliation.

galatea_observe_job.description: Observe the existing governed job and its recorded backend identity without resubmitting it.

galatea_plan_run.description: Persist a governed run plan bound to approved campaign revision, immutable inputs and budget; this is a mutation.

galatea_submit_job.description: Submit an authorized immutable plan using the required business idempotency key. Reconcile unknown outcomes; never blindly resubmit.

galatea_stop_job.description: Request stop of a scoped governed operation and preserve its receipt until backend termination is confirmed.

galatea_cancel_campaign.description: Request cancellation of an authorized campaign and reconcile its active operations; acknowledgement is not termination.

galatea_query_runs.description: Query scoped MLflow training and validation evidence through the Tracking API with bounded results.

galatea_get_metric_history.description: Read bounded metric history for an owned MLflow run under the approved evidence protocol.

galatea_get_artifact.description: Read the permitted evidence projection through the Artifact API after ownership and digest verification; never expose raw artifacts or test samples.

galatea_compare_runs.description: Compare compatible training and validation evidence only when dataset, split, preprocessing, metric and evaluation contracts match.

galatea_freeze_candidate.description: Freeze an owned candidate against immutable compatible evidence and campaign revision; does not promote a production alias.

galatea_verify_candidate.description: Verify the frozen candidate using the existing ownership, artifact digest, test-once and quality gates; does not change a production alias.
